# TypeScript Linter Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Frontend > TypeScript

## Overview

Configures ESLint with TypeScript parser and plugins for code quality enforcement, custom rules, and consistent coding standards

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [typescript-linter-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
typescript-linter-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@typescript-linter-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Configure eslint with typescript-eslint parser and plugin
- Set up type-aware linting rules
- Create custom ESLint rules for project conventions
- Configure flat config for modern ESLint setup

## Technology Standards Applied

- **typescript-eslint**: Official TypeScript ESLint parser and rules
- **Flat Config**: Modern ESLint flat configuration format
- **Type-Aware Rules**: Rules that use TypeScript type information
